task.description:
Implement SPT-01 per src/design/spt-01-schema-per-tenant-provisioning.md.

Files to create/modify:
1. migrations/060_schema_per_tenant_bootstrap.sql:
   - CREATE TABLE public.tenant_schemas(id UUID PK DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), tenant_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE, schema_name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), migrations_applied_at TIMESTAMPTZ).
   - ALTER TABLE public.schema_migrations ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS schema_name TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'public'.
   - Drop old UNIQUE constraint on schema_migrations(version) if it exists; add UNIQUE(schema_name, version).
   - CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION bpm_provision_tenant_schema(p_tenant_id UUID) RETURNS void as PL/pgSQL: compute schema name (strip hyphens; default UUID -> 'tenant_default'), advisory lock, CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS, INSERT INTO tenant_schemas ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING.

2. src/db/migrations.zig — add pub fn runForSchema(allocator, pool, migrations_dir, schema_name) MigrationError!void that sets search_path before iterating and records (schema_name, version) in public.schema_migrations. Existing run() must continue working (passes schema_name='public').

3. src/db/pool.zig — modify applyRequestTenantContext(): add schemaNameForTenant() helper, then SET search_path TO <schema_name>,public. KEEP the existing set_config('bpm.tenant_id',...) line — both must be present.

4. src/db/provisioning.zig (new) — pub fn provisionTenantSchema(allocator, pool, tenant_id_str, migrations_dir) !void: idempotency check via SELECT from tenant_schemas, then call bpm_provision_tenant_schema() SQL, then call migrations.runForSchema().

Validation: zig build && zig build test && zig build migrate — all exit 0. Commit to feature/WF02-spt-01.
acceptance_criteria: src/db/migrations.zig exports runForSchema with correct signature
src/db/pool.zig sets search_path AND keeps bpm.tenant_id set_config

result.summary: Implemented SPT-01 schema-per-tenant provisioning infrastructure: migration 060, runForSchema in migrations.zig, search_path in pool.zig, and provisioning.zig orchestrator.
